data.explanation: This is your landlord's annual statement of operating costs (Betriebskostenabrechnung) for your rented apartment, comparing your actual share of costs (€1,277.25) to the advance payments you already made (€1,200.00). The result is a back payment of €77.25, which the landlord asks you to pay by 8 January 2027. If you think an item is wrong, you can raise objections (Einwendungen) in writing; German law normally allows up to 12 months to do so, but it's worth checking the figures (consumption, allocation keys) and contacting a tenants' association if something looks off. If you miss the payment date, the landlord may send reminders or charge late interest.
